rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an inadequacy or an insufficient amount, including a health-related deficiency.

example.english: This report has a deficiency in its data.
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 zi1 liu2 bat1 zuk1

rows.note: Use this specifically when the deficiency is insufficient nutrition or nutrients rather than a general shortcoming.

example.english: Skipping meals all the time has caused a nutritional deficiency.
example.traditional: 佢成日唔食嘢，搞到營養不足。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sing4 jat6 m4 sik6 je5 gaau2 dou3 jing4 joeng5 bat1 zuk1
